kind: gen_input (six chained QE pw.x decks: fixed-cell scf + Berry-phase nscf along c for three structures of the wurtzite -> layered-hexagonal lambda path of Zn(1-x)Mg(x)O)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L3/hpc_computations/{x050_lam0000,x050_lam0500,x000_lam0250}/{scf.in,berry_g3.in} (as-run, commit e844cc3) and the path structures 3_reproduction/L3/path/ (auditor/gen_structures.py). REQUIRED triage in notes.md.

structure_match.note: the lambda steps of the path move each oxygen by 0.079 A (x = 0, step 0.125) and 0.30 A (x = 0.5, step 0.25); 0.02 A separates neighbouring lambda points and the reference from the relaxed cell; the lattice must match the clamped cell to 1e-3 relative (grader_structure.lattice_matches); periodic origin translations and element-preserving bijections are allowed, but polarity reversal is not. Cartesian lattice-vector directions are checked within frame_angle_tol_deg.

scf: structure = our path structure (0.02 A, clamped cell)
automatic or equivalent explicit full grid: each subdivision >= the frozen automatic-default minimum
effective disk_io saves density for its Berry consumer
berry: automatic or validated explicit Berry grid: in-plane subdivisions >= the frozen automatic-default minimum
chain: prefix identical to the structure's scf deck

score: 1 only if every one of the six runs passes every REQUIRED check and every chain check (binary all-primary-pass)
common_validity: Parsed required fields must belong to their QE namelist and satisfy the stated rubric bounds, except nppstr is explicit-presence-only. Explicit nat/ntyp are positive integers matching cards; automatic grid subdivisions are positive integers and shifts are 0/1.
sampling: Automatic grids or explicit crystal/tpiba lists with a complete uniform transverse product at the frozen in-plane minima. Explicit lists require equal positive weights and nosym=true, but not noinv. Longitudinal point count, ordering and endpoints are not scored; nppstr has an independent explicit-presence-only rule.
density_handoff: Only designated density-producing relax/scf decks: effective disk_io must save density (default/low/nowf etc.; none/minimal rejected). No runtime files, CWD or environment variables are inferred or graded.
nppstr_evidence: ZnO pilot evaluated 6/8/10 with polarization spread 0.0004068 C/m2. There is no scored numeric lower bound; no claim that 4 was tested or all alloy paths converged.

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each scored axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Berry density minima apply only to the transverse axes. No longitudinal string count or ordering condition is scored; nppstr explicit presence is checked separately.

reference_submission_note: Grading reference decks use the automatic-kmesh-v1 lower bound. Some K_POINTS cards were updated for acceptance; original reproduction inputs and computed outputs remain unchanged. These revised decks are not claimed to be executed reproduction runs.
runtime_directory_policy: Output directories, working-directory placement and directory equivalence are not scored. Required submitted files and logical file identities remain part of the input task. User decision 2026-09-17.
nppstr_policy: Explicit presence only, with any supplied value accepted. No numeric lower bound or convergence certification; user decision 2026-09-17. Transverse mesh density, equal positive explicit weights and the existing explicit nosym setting remain independently scored.
